paper_metadata.title: Harnessing Bayesian Statistics to Accelerate Iterative Quantum Amplitude Estimation

experiments.description: Scalability benchmark of amplitude estimation on an arbitrary quantum state using a standardized mock circuit, comparing Beta-BIQAE against Classical QAE, IQAE, BAE, MLQAE, FQAE, QAES, and Canonical QAE across target accuracies and amplitudes.

algorithm.variant: Beta-BIQAE (Bayesian Iterative Quantum Amplitude Estimation with beta prior)
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Iterate until the confidence/credible interval radius for the amplitude is smaller than target accuracy ε

target_accuracies: various target accuracies over multiple orders of magnitude

problem_formulation.objective_function: Estimate quantum amplitude a = Pr(|1⟩) from repeated measurements of an oracle-defined state
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Iterative quadrant-index tracking; Bayesian credible intervals replace frequentist confidence intervals

problem_instance.description: Benchmark amplitude estimation for a prespecified amplitude a = 0.5 and for arbitrary amplitudes a ∈ [0,1]

dataset_specification.description: Standardized quantum circuit design with mock Q-operators; amplitude a set to 0.5 for worst-case scaling and swept over a ∈ [0,1] in additional analysis

problem_instance.classical_preprocessing: None reported beyond constructing the mock circuit for classical simulation
problem_instance.classical_postprocessing: Convert credible interval for p_k to interval for θ and then to a; report quantum sample complexity and regression fits

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Use a simplified circuit design with mock Q-operators; simulate all methods with confidence level α = 0.05; for IQAE/BIQAE use incremental shot batch size Nincre = 10
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Take interval centers as point estimates for cross-method comparison; linear regression on log-log quantum sample complexity vs error; compute coverage rates and interval radii

classical_baselines.unit: approximately 5x higher constant factor than Beta-BIQAE (from text: Beta-BIQAE intercept is a multiplicative factor of five lower)

speedup_claims.conditions: for amplitude amplification-based estimation; Beta-BIQAE/IQAE-style methods
speedup_claims.caveats: The quadratic advantage is inherited from amplitude amplification; Bayesian inference mainly reduces the constant factor relative to IQAE.
Text also reports 12%–15% improvement across amplitudes and 10.5%–12.8% across ε ∈ {10^-2,...,10^-7}.
This is an intercept/constant-factor comparison, not a direct runtime benchmark.

speedup_claims.factor: Beta-BIQAE outperforms BAE, IQAE-CH, IQAE-CP, Canonical QAE, MLQAE, FQAE, QAES, and Classical QAE
speedup_claims.conditions: over five orders of magnitude in median absolute error
speedup_claims.caveats: Exact numeric gaps for each baseline are not fully enumerated in the text excerpt.

experiments.description: Molecular ground-state energy estimation using Beta-BIQAE versus Classical QAE and IQAE-CP for H2, LiH, HF, and BeH2 across bond lengths.

algorithm.variant: Beta-BIQAE applied to VQE-generated molecular states
algorithm.ansatz: Efficient SU(2) ansatz with full entanglement
algorithm.convergence_criteria: VQE optimization until ground-state wavefunction converges; max iterations per molecule reported

problem_formulation.objective_function: Estimate expectation values of molecular Hamiltonian terms to reconstruct ground-state energy
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Frozen core orbitals, qubit tapering, parity mapping; VQE prepares the ground state before QAE
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Electronic Hamiltonian generated in Qiskit Nature via PySCF, using parity mapping, frozen core orbitals, and qubit tapering

problem_instance.description: Ground-state energy estimation for diatomic and triatomic molecules at equilibrium bond length unless otherwise stated

dataset_specification.description: Molecules: H2, LiH, HF, BeH2; equilibrium bond length assumed unless otherwise stated; bond-length sweeps shown in figures; energies compared to exact diagonalization

problem_instance.classical_preprocessing: Generate Hamiltonians in Qiskit Nature via PySCF; parity mapping; frozen core orbitals; qubit tapering; prepare ground-state wavefunction with VQE
problem_instance.classical_postprocessing: Add nuclear repulsion and core electron energy; compare interval centers and radii to exact diagonalization and Classical QAE

implementation_details.framework_version: Qiskit Nature / Qiskit Runtime Estimator (versions not specified)
implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Hamiltonian generation in Qiskit Nature using PySCF; parity mapping; frozen core orbitals; qubit tapering; VQE ground-state preparation
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Compute expectation values classically via Qiskit Runtime Estimator primitive service with zero shots; add nuclear repulsion and core electron energy
